text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the sun is so dazzling... The brightest since the day
I was brought into this world... And yet—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I have finally surpassed the brilliance of that sun.
Yes, I am the one—the Royal Sun!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O claims a flawless victory—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The struggle for the leading role between generations that raged since late last year
has finally drawn to a close! The new era has at last begun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, how is it?
Behold the form of the "End of the Century Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"As its creator,
how does it look to you?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? But do not forget.
In the eyes of others, you too are already
shining just as brightly.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because we are... twin suns.
The strongest in history.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, won't you lead me by the hand to the throne,
Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one left who can hold my hand
without melting from sheer reverence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her fair hand respectfully,
I lead her to the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My beloved fans, you have done splendidly!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hear my declaration! Through this victory,
T.M. Opera O has become the Overlord of the End of the Century!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The End of the Century has come!
No one can stand against me anymore, no one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone.
Do you know what makes a king?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Many things come to mind, no doubt. But there is one absolute truth.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That is to 'never betray their trust.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I have run as befits the "Overlord,"
and I have achieved results worthy of the title.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And from now on, as the "Overlord of the Century's End,"
I vow to keep achieving absolute victory, eternal triumph,
and extending my undefeated streak!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So place your faith in me and worship.
I swear I will answer that loyalty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The margin of victory shown today—
is one that no one can ever close!
For it is proof of surpassing a great generation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year, a new season will dawn,
where I reign as the absolute King!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone could feel a strength far beyond the margin of victory.
An absolute—strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O put on a magnificent display of strength,
powerful enough to overpower even the previous generation.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Mggggh, I've been completely outdone, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, are you really satisfied with this!?
How can you move on to the next stage
like this!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed. For a parting gift, that was quite a severe one to receive...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll talk with Spe-chan... and maybe keep running in the Twinkle Series for a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A bird cannot take flight with lingering attachments in its heart.
I shall deliver a pristine run that will not lose to the 'Overlord of the End of the Century.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we shall now commence the founding
ceremony of the T.M. Opera O Dynasty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: First, an introduction of the dynasty's members.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the King! I'm the Queen! I'm the Prince!
I'm the Princess!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The princess's pampered pet dog: me!
...And that covers the core cast.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And standing by the side of the "Overlord of the Century's End,"
the tremendously successful Knight Commander is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's you!
Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyauuuu, m-me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. You have both the right and the duty to do so.
You must always run alongside me."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And living next to the royal castle,
sometimes coming over to play, is the daughter of the Ayabe family—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's Admire Vega, also known as Ayabe-san!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I really... don't want to participate...
They seem like a total nobody anyway...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As if it didn't matter. Without House Ayabe,
the current royal family wouldn't even exist.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I hope we continue to have a wonderful relationship... as neighbors!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ehhh...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And for our dynasty,
the most indispensable person is—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's my trainer,
who guided me to the throne!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Introduced by T.M. Opera O,
I stepped onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Without the bond I share with Trainer-kun,
my absolute reign would never have come to be.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And fighting side by side like this...
is the very ambition I initially intended.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I, an Umamusume, team up with you, a human,
and we win together...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That will become the symbol of interspecies harmony!
Only by joining hands can different species become the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! In my kingdom, all races are equal!
Yes, except for me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let everyone join hands, support one another, and prosper beneath the aegis of the Overlord of the Century's End!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: One Earth! One race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"We Race Together!
This is the true reason why I aimed to become the 'Overlord of the Century's End'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's victory.
And a hidden ambition revealed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A wave of emotion washed over Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... can tell.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's no way he thought that up from the start.
He definitely just winged it along the way...
